text:
maya: heads-up from zen-v1 int8 onboarding. we're seeing intermittent CJK grapheme splits and flipped parentheses in mixed-ar/latin samples, but only during stochastic sampling. greedy/beam look fine. anyone run into an int8-only sampling instability? :thinking:
david: paste quick numbers + a tiny repro please
maya: short run (staging, quant=int8, sampler=top-p=0.92,temp=0.75). summary below: 
```
# n=120 per-locale samples
locale  mean_entropy  token_split_rate  kl_vs_float
en      3.05          0.012            0.00
zh      5.3           0.082            1.85
ja      5.0           0.069            1.6
ar      4.3           0.053            1.0
```
# repro zh src: "\u6211\u8981\u66f4\u6539\u5de5\u4f5c\u4efb\u52a1\u5217\u8868\u3002"
sampleA: "\u6211 \u8981 \u66f4\u6539 \u5de5 \u4f5c \u4efb \u52a1 \u5217 \u8868\u3002"
sampleB: "\u6211\u8981\u66f4\u6539\u5de5\u4f5c\u4efb\u52a1\u5217\u8868\uff0c"
# mixed ar+en src: "\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0645 (report-42) \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062f\u064a\u0621"
sample: "\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0645 )report-42( \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062f\u064a\u0621"
```
david: big KL jump. Greedy stable suggests tail logits noise amplified by sampling. Did you compare float logits vs int8?
maya: yes, for a problematic prefix float logits show a clear head and long-decaying tail; int8 logits bunch many CJK subtokens in a narrow band. gist attached (private): https://gist.github.com/redwood/zen-logits-dump.
rene: two parallel hypotheses: (1) detok/tokenizer codepath divergence for sampling vs greedy, (2) numeric jitter in softmax/attention kernels for int8. Any recent runtime or detok changes?
kia: infra note: last week we deployed "fast-softmax-int8" and a small "detok-fast-byte" optimization to reduce memory. rolling back either could be informative.
maya: forcing `--detok=utf8-normalize` reduced token_split_rate from 0.082 -> 0.04 but didn't restore baseline. lowering temp to 0.6 also reduces splits but BLEU still lags by ~0.9 on zh->en.
david: please run a limited 2x2 matrix: (runtime: float-softmax vs fast-softmax-int8) x (detok: fast-byte vs utf8-normalize) with quant=int8 and quant=float weights where possible. Use n=64 to keep fast. capture per-step softmax inputs and rank-order deltas for the CJK span.
rene: add a bisect over the commits that touched softmax and detok in the last 3 weeks. if we see a step-change in entropy or split_rate, we can blame the kernel or detok change.
ci-bot: CI sampling-eval zen-v1 int8 queued (run id: ci-7399). link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7399 :rocket:
kia: short-term mitigation proposal: in the onboarding checklist, if token_split_rate_delta(CJK) > 0.04 or sampling_entropy_delta > 0.8 vs float baseline, block the quantized onboarding. Also recommend conservative sampling defaults for CJK (top-p <= 0.85, temp <= 0.65) in docs until root cause fixed.
david: also add a regression unit test: compare sample entropy distribution (quant vs float baseline) for a small curated prompt set (CJK punctuation, furigana-like constructs, mixed LTR/RTL). fail if KL > 1.0 or split_rate delta > 0.03. We'll add to onboarding pipeline.
maya: created ticket ML-1824 with examples, logits, and CI run id. Assign @david to run matrix & bisect, @rene to confirm detok fast-path usage, @kia to coordinate potential hotfix reverts. I'll upload the prompt set to /datasets/onboard/zen/locale-spot.json and update the ticket in ~4h. :thumbsup:
